description: This Java class 'SpmService' provides services for managing 'Survey' entities within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes methods to fetch, create, update, activate, and deactivate surveys, handling security context and data validation, as well as managing data integrity issues. The class interacts with the survey repository and validator, and manages survey lifecycle events, applying business rules such as ensuring only one active survey per key and setting valid date ranges.

classes.name: SpmService
classes.description: Service class handling survey management operations including creation, update, activation, deactivation, and retrieval, with integrated security, validation, and data integrity management.

methods.name: fetchValidSurveys
methods.description: Returns a list of currently active surveys, after authenticating the user.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Returns a list of all surveys, after authenticating the user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a survey by its ID, throws exception if not found, after authenticating the user.

methods.name: createSurvey
methods.description: Creates a new survey after validation, handles previous survey deactivation by key, sets valid date range, and manages data integrity exceptions.

methods.name: updateSurvey
methods.description: Updates an existing survey after validation and handles data integrity issues.

methods.name: deactivateSurvey
methods.description: Deactivates a survey by setting its 'validTo' date to yesterday, after user authentication.

methods.name: activateSurvey
methods.description: Reactivates a survey by resetting its 'validFrom' and 'validTo' dates, after user authentication.

methods.name: getStartOfToday
methods.description: Utility method returning the start of the current day based on tenant local date.
